resolution: Usage guidance for the multi-texture flow on cereal_box_01 (no code change). Walked the exact steps: RETURN out of the focused UV workspace (PAINT VARIANTS is hidden there by design), Save Painting FIRST to lock the current imported-atlas look as Painting 1, then RMB canvas > Texture Atlas > Import Texture… for the second image, remap islands, then click New (not Update Painting 1) to fork Painting 2. Flagged the Update-vs-New footgun explicitly and the recovery paths (journaled undo / Load Painting 1). Also covered per-instance selection in the world via right-click > PAINTINGS.
